posts.title: On Signing Work
posts.description: I was recently very lucky to be able to publicly associate my name with a tangible form of my work . It’s an opportunity that comes infrequently in my profession. posts.title: Go Further With MapKit
posts.description: I don’t typically write about my 9-to-5, but I had to make an exception to share this video. It’s a technical presentation I gave at this year’s Worldwide Developers Conference for Apple. I’m very proud of it. If you’re not an application developer you’ll probably find it pretty dry. But it’s a cool look at some what I’ve spent the last few years doing.
